up: Retrieve all distinct molecules that are reported in document CHEMBL5727722. Return the molecule's ChEMBL ID (chembl_id) and preferred name (pref_name).
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id,
    md.pref_name
FROM docs d
JOIN activities a ON d.doc_id = a.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5727722';
